evidence_items.publisher: Yuntian Deng, Yejin Choi and Stuart Shieber, arXiv
evidence_items.explanation: The authors report that a specially trained GPT-2 Small reaches 99% accuracy on nine-by-nine-digit multiplication. Different training and models make this contextual counterevidence against a universal incapacity claim, rather than a contradiction of o1-mini's measured failures.
